title: canthium subcapitatum
intro: Canthium subcapitatum, commonly known as the East Indian cherry, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which have been utilized to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Canthium subcapitatum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and swelling, and protecting against cell damage. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
